items.what: Combat and stealth perk trees, plus stamina costs for light attacks, sprinting, jumping, drawing a bow and sneaking, an exhaustion debuff at 0 Stamina, and its own armor rating scaling.
items.build: Stamina is the limiting resource for melee and archery builds; stamina regeneration and cost reduction perks matter more than in vanilla.

items.what: Wolf, Hawk and Bear stances for melee. Paragon's weapon and unarmed trees branch by stance: Wolf bleeds, Hawk crits, Bear shreds armor and poise.
items.build: Pick one stance branch per weapon tree; perks from other branches do nothing while you fight in a different stance.

items.what: A dodge on a key. Heavy armor and clothing give a short step with fewer invulnerability frames, light armor a longer roll with more.
items.build: Light Armor builds get the better dodge; Paragon's Acrobat and Edgerunner and the Shadow stone build on it.

items.what: Poise: hits drain a poise bar and stagger when it breaks; shown on TrueHUD.
items.build: Poise damage and poise resistance perks (Hawk/Bear branches, Unstoppable, Tower stone, Talos) decide who staggers first.

items.what: Limits repeated staggering so neither side can be stun-locked forever.
items.build: Stagger is strong but not infinite; plan a follow-up, not a loop.

items.what: Blocking commits you: you can't cancel attacks into a block freely.
items.build: Timed blocks matter more than holding block; see Paragon's Block tree.

items.what: Reworks block behaviour and block hit reactions.
items.build: Pairs with Paragon's timed block (330 ms window) and its Block perks.

items.what: Real weapon collision instead of the vanilla hit cone; weapon length and swing arcs decide hits.
items.build: Reach matters: Paragon edits reach settings, and long weapons hit from further away.

items.mod: Stages of Suffering - An SKSE Death Alternative
items.what: Dying gives Minor, Moderate or Severe injuries instead of a reload; sleep 8+ hours somewhere safe to heal.
items.build: Injuries stack and weaken you; the Lady stone lets you pay gold to skip them.

items.what: Apostasy's own rules: difficulty damage multipliers, Attacks of Opportunity (+50% against power attacking, casting, drawing or staggered targets), Massive Targets, Bloodied enemies and Confusion for mages hit in melee.
items.build: Punish openings: attacks of opportunity and backstabs carry extra damage and poise damage; giants and dragons resist it.

items.what: Character XP comes from quests, discovery, clearing and kills, not from using skills.
items.build: Skill levels are bought with points on level up (Static Skill Leveling), so you plan skills instead of grinding them.

items.what: Edits combat styles so NPCs are more aggressive and press attacks.
items.build: Expect sustained pressure; defensive perks and stamina management pay off.

items.what: Lets NPCs chain attack combos with modern movesets.
items.build: Enemy strings are longer; timed blocks and dodges beat trading hits.

items.what: Smarter melee positioning and circling for NPCs.
items.build: Enemies flank more; area control and staggers help in groups.

items.what: Melee NPCs close distance with lunges instead of chasing slowly.
items.build: Kiting is harder; ranged builds need slows, roots or a way to stagger.

items.what: NPCs dodge based on their skill and situation.
items.build: Skilled enemies avoid some attacks; ranged and spell builds see more misses.

items.what: Enemy archers and casters lead their shots.
items.build: Strafing no longer dodges arrows reliably; shields and the Block tree's arrow reduction help.

items.mod: NPCs Take Cover - Smarter Anti-Cheese AI
items.what: NPCs retreat and take cover when you exploit terrain they can't reach.
items.build: Perching out of reach doesn't win fights.

items.what: NPCs drink potions from their inventory when hurt.
items.build: Burst damage and poison (Overdose, Intensity) shorten fights before they heal.

items.what: Better behaviour for summons and thralls.
items.build: Summoner builds are more reliable.

items.what: Player and NPCs flinch briefly when hit by melee without being fully staggered.
items.build: Getting hit interrupts more; Heavy Armor's defensive perks soften it.

items.what: Melee hits push targets back so modern movesets don't clip into enemies.
items.build: Spacing shifts during combos.

items.what: Bandits get varied archetypes, gear and behaviour.
items.build: Bandit camps hit harder than vanilla early on.

items.what: Forsworn get new archetypes and abilities.
items.build: The Reach is a step up in danger.

items.mod: The Dragon Cult - A Draugr Overhaul
items.what: Draugr get new types, ranks and tactics.
items.build: Nordic ruins test sustained fights; Sun and fire damage are useful against undead.

items.what: Draugr use modern attack movesets.
items.build: Draugr combos punish standing still.

items.what: Overhauls many enemy types and their stats.
items.build: Enemy toughness differs from vanilla expectations.

items.what: Reworked dragon combat and variety.
items.build: Dragons are Massive Targets: reduced attack-of-opportunity damage, no backstabs. Dragonrend and ranged damage matter.

items.what: Dragon priests become humanoid boss fights.
items.build: Boss fights reward burst and stagger resistance.

items.what: Areas have fixed level ranges instead of scaling with you.
items.build: Some places are much harder at low level; plan a route that matches your level.

items.what: Drinking potions plays an animation and slows you.
items.build: Healing mid-fight takes time; regeneration and on-hit healing are more valuable.

items.what: Hotkeys and auto-use for potions.
items.build: Convenience; doesn't remove the drinking animation.

items.what: Menus don't pause the game.
items.build: Inventory juggling during combat is dangerous; set up favourites and the wheel beforehand.

items.what: Alchemy overhaul; Apostasy makes restore potions short (4 s) but strong.
items.build: Potions are bursts, not long heals.

items.what: Magic overhaul adding Poison and Sun spells and rebalancing schools.
items.build: Paragon's Corrupted Catalyst and Adamant's Destruction perks also apply to Mysticism's Poison and Sun spells.

items.what: Destruction perks apply to non-elemental spells too (Desecration, Natura).
items.build: More spell choices count for Destruction perks.

items.mod: Sorcerer - A Staff and Scroll Overhaul
items.what: Staves and scrolls become a real playstyle.
items.build: Pairs with the Ritual stone (scrolls and staves stronger, regular spells weaker) and Enchanting's Sage perks.

items.what: Enchanting overhaul.
items.build: Weapon and armor enchantment strength follows the Enchanting tree.

items.what: Reworks artifacts and unique items.
items.build: Unique items can carry a build; the Oghma Infinium also gives 2 perk points.

items.what: Hunger, exhaustion and warmth.
items.build: Needs carry penalties into fights; frost resistance (Nords) and food buffs (Gourmet) help.
